evals.prompt: Audit an Apps Script web app that executes as the owner. The client sends role='admin', server functions trust it, and user comments are rendered with innerHTML and later exported to Sheets.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized findings and fixes for broken authorization, XSS, formula injection, execution identity, scopes, safe errors, regression tests, and deployment settings.

evals.prompt: Review an authorized Apps Script webhook integration. The shared secret is in Index.html, arbitrary callback URLs are accepted, and failed POSTs retry forever.
evals.expected_output: A safe review covering secret rotation/storage, URL allowlisting, signature/replay verification, bounded retry and idempotency, logging redaction, and residual platform constraints.
